bosses.name: Orb Chaos
bosses.strategy:
She has several different spells that will increase her stats by 25-30%,
so once she's done doing that, be very careful, as they went from very
strong to deadly. She WILL almost kill Yuri in one set of attacks once
her attack is boosted, she's THAT strong! Alice won't have time to do
anything except Arc once Orb Chaos starts attacking.

Other than the boosting spells, Orb Chaos attacks normally for major
damage, and uses a spell called Expression that can not only do pretty
good damage, but can also Paralyze your entire party! If you don't have
those Crucifixes equipped, good luck winning, especially when she starts
using Expression each turn, one after another.

Even though he may barely have enough SP to do it, have Yuri fuse into
Amon, then have one of the girls use a Pure Seed/Root on him to give him
some breathing room, then have him attack normally. Alice should be
casting Arc every round, and Margarete should be attacking normally every
round, since both she and Yuri should have Mind's Eyes equipped.

NOTE     Once the battle is over, you'll receive Alice's best weapon,
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   the Holy Book-Flesh.

  NOTE     Make sure Alice is in your party, otherwise Runaway Ewan won't tell
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   you about the Dollhouse.

After entering Prague, make your way all the way to the north end of town and
talk to the Silent Peddler. He is now selling items, and man, are they GOOD! If
you have some extra cash built up, you may want to stock up on each of the Mana
and Pure Extracts, but not Thera Extracts; you can get those for 100 steps
apiece with the Pedometer Service. You may also want to take the opportunity to
get some Third Keys; they can make some boss battles go by WAY quicker if a
beefed-up Yuri hits all 9 areas. :-D

After shopping, make your way to the bar and talk to Runaway Ewan, who's just
below the Owner and Yuria; he'll tell you about a possessed house, and asks
that you exorcise it. By talking to him, we've now opened a new area of the
World Map: the Dollhouse. Leave Prague, then head into the Dollhouse.

  NOTE     You should probably equip the two Crucifixes you have as well, and
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   probably a combination Zodiac and Cosmic Bracelet on the third
           person. Check out the status effects of the enemies below to see
           why.

  NOTE     Alice must be in your party to be able to do anything here.
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
After the quick scene, you'll regain control as Alice. Before entering the
house, head over to the left and examine the ground below the barrels to find
the [_ORACLE EARRINGS_]. Go inside the house and use the Save Point if you
wish, then examine the grandfather clock to your left to find a [_CRANK_].

Go into the room to the upper-right of the Save Point and examine the table
just below you as you enter for a [_LOTTERY TICKET_]. Go up the stairs to your
upper-left and through the doorway here to be at a fountain. Go up to the left
side of it and examine it to have to do a Push Ring. When you complete it
successfully, you'll receive the [_STOREROOM KEY_].

Head back outside of the house and examine the western door near where you
found the Oracle Earrings. With the key, you can now go through here, so do so,
then examine the generator above you to use the Crank to start it. To your
upper-right, you should see some shovels and a bucket; examine the bucket to
find a [_SILVER HAND_]. Climb down the ladder to your right, then check at the
very bottom of the screen; where you see the two bottles and the glass, you'll
find a [_SLIDE_] plate.

Make your way back into the other side of the house, then go up the stairs to
the left of the Save Point and into the room here. Examine the projector on the
table to the right to use the Slide, where you'll see that the picture
projected was taken on December 24, or 1224.

Go back downstairs and into the room to the right. Examine the dial beside the
fireplace, and you'll be able to enter a code. Enter 1224, then make your way
back to the Save Point, making sure to both Save and recover, as we're taking
on a boss next.

Go back outside, then through the storeroom, down the ladder, then down and
right to the door here. Go through it, then down the stairs to a large door
that you can now open since the water has been drained.

Okay, be honest... Did you jump when you first walked into the room to see the
doll baby riding the rocking horse? I played Resident Evil: Nemesis when I was
a bit too young, so certain things catch me off guard...

In any case, before exploring too much, open the chest at the foot of the bed
for a [_CRUCIFIX_]. You should now have THREE of them!

  NOTE     Take the time now to equip each party member with a Crucifix, or at
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   least a Zodiac or Rosewood Bracelet.

When you're ready, try to leave the room... *shudder*

After the battle, make sure to equip Alice's best weapon. That's it for here,
so head back out onto the World Map.

  NOTE     You can return here later if you like, but you have to make sure
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   Alice is in your party.

If you like, you can return to Prague and go to the bar. There's an interesting
detail on the floor where Ewan was standing if you want to check that out.
Otherwise, we're finished and ready for the next quest.
